segments.oily: Oily-skinned reviewers frequently report smaller pores, reduced surface oil, and cleared blackheads, especially when diluting with water rather than full-strength apple cider vinegar.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin found it effective on scarring and blackheads but caution that it can be drying, recommending a moisturizing routine in the days before first use and a shorter wear time.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are split: some broke out badly after just two applications, while others with a mostly-oily combination type report clear, pimple-free stretches with regular weekly use.
segments.sensitive: Many sensitive-skinned reviewers were warned off after painful nodules or a bad breakout, yet others with sensitive skin report no issues at all when they mix with water instead of vinegar and limit wear time to about 10 minutes.
segments.normal: A reviewer describing dryish/normal skin with enlarged, reaction-prone pores found it reduced pore size and calmed irritation left by a prior extraction tool, with only temporary redness for a few hours after.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s and 70s use it on the face, neck, and chest for discoloration, scarring, and enlarged pores, reporting it exfoliates without discomfort and leaves skin looking and feeling younger.

concerns.aging: A few older reviewers (40s to 70s) credit regular use with smoother, younger-looking skin and fading discoloration and scarring, though this reflects only a handful of individual accounts rather than a broad consensus.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers note the mask is drying, especially with repeated apple cider vinegar use, and recommend moisturizing immediately after and cutting back to once weekly or every other week if skin starts to feel tight or dry.
concerns.redness: Temporary facial redness after removal is reported by a large share of reviewers, usually fading within 10 to 30 minutes; a few describe more intense, longer-lasting redness or a sunburn-like sting, while a couple of reviewers experienced no redness at all.
concerns.barrier: A minority describe a more compromised reaction: one developed extremely sensitive, itchy red patches after mixing with raw apple cider vinegar that a doctor linked to the vinegar's acidity, and another had painful nodules and inflamed skin after repeated use.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading acne scarring, dark spots, and uneven discoloration with regular use, alongside a visible reduction in blackheads and enlarged pores.
concerns.blemishes: Results on acne are the most polarized concern: many describe cystic acne drying up within days and fewer new breakouts, while several others report the opposite — new cystic pimples, pus-filled bumps, or a worse breakout after just one or two uses.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skinned reviewers consistently report the mask absorbs excess surface oil and leaves skin matte, though a few note it can strip too much oil if used more often than weekly.

extraits.titre: d my skin type: oily, sensitive, easily irritable, acne prone (whiteheads, blackheads, cysts).
extraits.texte: This review is a lot like the others. My skin type is super sensitive, extremely oily, and riddled with acne. All forms of acne. Whiteheads, black, heads, cysts. Acne that isn't just unpleasant to look at but actually hurts. I am very pale but my face always has been a shade of pink of red. Very uneven skin tone. And I'm allergic to salysilic acid. So most acne treatments do t work for me. But so far, this product has been great. It bas decreased the amount of oil my face produces and significantly made my pores smaller all while cleaning all the gunk out of them. Only complaint so far, it is hard to clean up once you are done.DO NOT WASH IT DOWN YOUR DRAIN IT WILL BLOCK IT I PROMISE YOU. KEEP IN MIND THIS IS MUD. I mix it with apple cider vinegar (which makes it smell kind a bad) and then lather it on my face. I make a big amount of it and store it in my kitchen so I can use it later. After putting it on my face I pet my cats or read a book for 20 to 45 minutes. I usually leave it on a long time because then it is easier to take off. Now the hardest part. Taking this thing off your face. This is what I do. Go to the bathroom, stand over the sink and block your drain. I put two prices of paper towel in the sink to catch the falling mud chips. Then move your face. While you were petting cats or reading books or whatever for 20 to 45 minutes your face froze. So now move it around to break up the mud. Then just peel it off with your hands and collect it all in the paper towel. T

extraits.titre: Unfortunately, not for all skin types!!
extraits.texte: As we know, what may work for others may not always work for you. I have oily/combination skin. When I first used this, I did the patch test on my arm— no redness so I considered this the green light. I used the mask a couple of times and by that, I mean twice. I’ve broken out terribly on my right cheek so I’m backing away from it altogether. I had little pus-filled bumps that I’ve never seen flare up before and I suffer from hormonal acne (yay!) but this was not it for me. I used little pimple patches (those work like hero, curology etc) so you can see where THAT worked (the dark, dry blood spots) but I recommend to even do a small test on a part of your face if you dare. I did want to like this product but money down the drain and it’s currently sitting in the trash 🤭. Good luck to those who try it though!

extraits.titre: The only acne cure that worked for me
extraits.texte: This is quite possibly the best skincare product I have ever used. I don’t say that lightly as I am a self-confessed beauty junky and cystic acne sufferer. But holy hell, this mask literally changed my life in less than a week. I was pretty skeptical despite the other glowing reviews. I’ve tried Spironolactone, antibiotics, snail creams, vitamins, lasers, retinol, microdermabrasion, monthly facials, birth control pills, homeopathic herbs and remedies and NOTHING, I repeat, NOTHING has cleared my angry, inflamed cystic acne quicker than this mask. I have very oily skin and hormonal acne along my jawline. It’s summer time and so I’m sweating like crazy. Combine all that with the fact that it’s COVID 2.0 and I’ve got masker all over my chin. This mask is a godsend. I apply it every single day for exactly ten minutes before showering. Yes it makes your face red, yes it removes acne scars and inflammation, yes it actually works. Within three days, my cysts has dried up completely and flattened (which would’ve taken at least two weeks normally.) No new pimples have emerged and my skin is younger looking, less spotty, and much softer. I even use this mask on my backne and my shoulders look like they belong to Heidi Klum. I am beyond thrilled. I’m over the moon. I keep waiting for another spot to emerge but think maybe, if this just becomes my nightly routine, I might be able to keep my adult acne at bay. Pro tip though: Do not wash the mud down the drain. It will clog your pipes!

Yes, you do turn red and if you’re pale like me, REALLY red. Don’t panic, it’s not a chemical burn, it dissipates within 30 mins like the package says. Included a pic of the redness for reference. I have dry skin and wasn’t sure this was the mask for me until I tried it, but I wanted to treat my acne, flaky skin, blackheads, and acne scars. Well, it worked. Second pic is before and after 1 use with half water half apple cider vinegar. I know the pics aren’t quite the same quality, but you can see a reduction in the active acne around my mouth and the discoloration of the scarring. It tightened up my loose skin too and LOADS of dead skin and blackheads just fell off afterward. I ended up dermaplaning because I didn’t want to scrub right afterward and needed to get all the dead skin off. I exfoliate regularly and had no idea so much dead skin could possibly be on my face. I mean, peels don’t take this much off my skin or out of my pores. I left it on for 25 mins even though I have sensitive skin because I wanted to wait until all areas dried (I may have applied it thicker than necessary) but it didn’t cause any problems. It dries SOLID and it’s not comfortable and removing it with a warm wet microfiber cloth made my eyes water. I’d imagine using your fingers will be even more uncomfortable. Completely worth the redness and discomfort, both are temporary, but both are a bit alarming if you’re not expecting it, so... expect it. Great value for money, I barely used any to make a f

I dont know if I'll use this again. My face did a good purging for about two weeks. Then had great, clear, soft skin. I continued using the same way, then bam! I had the worst breakout of my life! My face was so red, inflamed, and painful sores, hard nodules under the skin. I dont know if it was another purge (can you have more then one?) Anyways, as soon as I stopped using this my skin began to calm down again, but I'm still recovering from this. Also to add I did use with apple cider vinegar. I wouldn't recommend for sensitive people.

This is my second time buying this clay because I love it so much.This stuff has helped clean my pores and clean out all the old oil,dirt and dead skin in them. Before I was using an extractor tool but it was enlarging them and making the problem worse and was causing red bumps all over my face.I have dryish/normal skin but with somewhat large pores, I'm 25 years old and my skin is a little bit sensitive too and by mixing one tablespoon of clay one tablespoon of apple cider vinegar and a tablespoon of warm water in a plastic bowl with plastic spoon and letting it dry for 20 minutes I've little by little been getting clear skin!! I do this twice a week, afterwards my skin is a little red for about 2-3 hours.I bought the 2 pound jar I loved this stuff so much!

extraits.titre: Amazing feeling! Tighter skin and I glow!!!
extraits.texte: Product arrived quickly. Was able to try it today and I have to say it feels wonderful! Several reviews noted a small scoop that is supposed to be included but maybe because I ordered to larger size, I had no scoop. It is fine as I just used a small plastic spoon and a glass custard dish to mix this mask (the instructions advise against using metal. Not sure why, but I didn't take any chances!). Another thing that I found really funny is that the directions say to put the mask on at a thickness of 1/4"-1/2". There is no way you can do that on your face (not only would it never go on that thick, it would just fall off in chunks!) so perhaps that is intended for body wraps. A nice tingling sensation is felt - even using the vinegar - but it is not at all uncomfortable. I am a 49 year old woman who is blessed with good genes. I have only three small wrinkles on my forehead - probably from repeated eyebrow raising over the years, lol! I did have acne as a teen and well into adulthood and have mild to moderate scarring and discoloration "spots" as well as current issues of blackheads still on my nose & chin. I also have enlarges pores - all of which I would like to see gone or minimized! I plan to use this mask once or twice a week on BOTH my face, neck and chest (so many women focus on their face, ignoring their neck and chest... The neck, chest and hands are what show age more if not treated as well - or so I am told!). I am told that I look at least ten years younger than I am
